title: impl_string_enum_serde\! macro has undocumented implicit requirement: enum must have Other(String) variant
description: The macro in submission.rs hardcodes $ty::Other(v) => v.as_str() in its generated Serialize impl. This compiles only if the enum has a variant named Other(String). The requirement is not documented in the macro definition. A contributor who tries to apply the macro to an enum without Other(String) gets a confusing compile error. A #[doc] comment on the macro (if moved to pub(crate)) should say 'The enum MUST have an Other(String) variant for unknown/future values; this variant is not listed in the known values list and is matched as the catch-all.'
